Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production transparent sprite of an integrated WEST-facing wall aperture for a nearly overhead orthographic 2.5D factory-campus kiosk.
Input image: style reference and example of the WRONG existing entrance. Keep its muted sage corrugated metal and aged cream plaster, but replace the orientation completely.

CRITICAL GEOMETRY: The player enters horizontally from LEFT to RIGHT into the building. Draw TWO SHORT PARALLEL HORIZONTAL WALL RETURNS: one across the TOP edge and one across the BOTTOM edge. They run EAST/WEST (left-to-right), framing a clear HORIZONTAL corridor between them. Canvas roughly width:height 0.75:1. Top wall occupies upper 15% of canvas; bottom wall occupies lower 17%. The entire broad middle 68% is TRANSPARENT and continuously open all the way from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge. This is a pair of jamb walls viewed from above, NOT a tall upright frontal doorway. NO vertical upright at left or right, NO vertical bar connecting top and bottom, NO overhead arch bridging north and south. The two returns are visibly thick, with narrow sage steel coping/top surfaces and short shaded cream inner faces. Doorless opening about two character widths from north wall to south wall; depth from left mouth to right interior about one character height. Keep the geometry rectangular and axis-aligned, no diagonal isometric footprint.

At the outer LEFT end of the LOWER wall return, a SHORT squat cream plaster wall pier (no taller than the lower wall band), sage lower edging, tiny practical brass wall lamp mounted beside a horizontal small cream plaque bearing exact text "入口". This pier belongs to and is continuous with the lower horizontal wall, not freestanding. A small shallow corrugated sage weather hood may cover just the TOP wall return, following its horizontal run; no protruding vertical posts below it. Worn restrained paint and softly shaded inside return faces provide wall thickness. Omit long surrounding building walls, roof, shop facade, cashier, shelves and all other furniture; the engine supplies these.

ALPHA REQUIREMENTS: transparent background everywhere outside the two wall returns, and genuine fully transparent middle passage. No solid floor, no opaque dark rectangle or shelf painted behind opening, no threshold step, no rail, no door leaf, hinges, handles, curtain, shutter or hanging green strip. No scenery or people or UI or board labels. The transparent passage will expose the game's actual indoor gray floor from left to right.
Render as a crisp hand-painted architectural game sprite with the reference's soft overhead daylight, small scuffs and muted palette. Neutral shadows ONLY on solid inner wall faces, no large cast shadow outside silhouette. Do not draw an upright U-shaped portal: this is top and bottom horizontal walls for a WEST-facing cutout, not front-facing door art. Fill canvas with both returns, keep small margins, all components visible.
